intro.lede: We meet the most demanding customer needs in the transport of high-volume material and goods across Europe.
intro.p1: We specialise in high-volume transport between EU member states. We operate our own fleet of nearly 100 DAF and Mercedes-Benz rigs, which we renew regularly. Our drivers cover more than 8.5 million kilometres each year.
intro.p2: Our headquarters are in Hlubočky near Olomouc. The dispatch hotline runs twenty-four hours a day. Our coordinators speak several world languages fluently.

aboutPage.metaDescription: A solid, purely Czech road carrier since 1991. Specialising in high-volume transport between EU states. 150 employees, 100 vehicles, ISO 9001.
aboutPage.heroDescription: Our core mission is to fulfil our customers' needs in the shortest time and at the lowest cost. Our reward: hundreds of satisfied clients.
aboutPage.philosophyTitle: To serve so well that the customer never has to think about logistics at all.
aboutPage.p1: We are a stable, purely Czech road carrier. The company has been operating since 1991. Over more than a quarter of a century, we have gradually specialised in the transport of high-volume cargo.
aboutPage.p2: J.M.I.T. employs 150 people across two divisions — classic trucking and a division for European partners. Our drivers cover more than 8.5 million kilometres a year — the equivalent of more than 220 trips around the Equator.
aboutPage.p3: Our headquarters are in Hlubočky near Olomouc. The dispatch hotline runs twenty-four hours a day. Our coordinators speak several world languages fluently and have unparalleled command of road logistics.
aboutPage.p4: We sustain our high service standards through trained drivers and technicians. It is not unusual for our drivers to stay with us for over twenty years.
aboutPage.historyTitle: More than three decades on the road.

timeline.text: Granted a permit for international transport.
Beginning of cooperation with a major Luxembourg partner in air freight.
Services extended to include warehousing, distribution and customs clearance.
Branch office opened in Nuremberg, Germany. Purchase and renovation of our own facilities.
Lloyd's Register Quality Assurance audit and ISO 9001:2000 certification.
Fleet expanded with 10 DAF tractors. ECHOTRACK tracking system deployed.
Change of legal form — transformed from a sole proprietor to a joint-stock company.
Fleet extended with the Mercedes-Benz brand and gradual renewal of high-volume DAF rigs.
New livery design across the trucks.

servicesPage.metaDescription: High-volume transport, international and domestic road freight, forwarding, logistics and cargo insurance.
servicesPage.heroDescription: We specialise in high-volume transport between EU states, but we also handle domestic shipments and complete logistics.

velkoobjemova-preprava.lede: International transport of high-volume goods at the highest quality and the shortest time.
bullets: Dozens of modern DAF and Mercedes rigs
Coordinators fluent in CZ / DE / EN
body: Our partners include manufacturers of automotive components, tyres, white goods and insulation materials. We use rigs with the largest possible cargo space allowed on the road — our trucks have a capacity of up to 38 Euro pallets.

We operate primarily in international transport across all of Europe. Germany is dominant — both as a transit country and as the destination for a large share of our shipments. We also deliver high-volume goods to the UK, Hungary, Romania and the Benelux. We have recently begun running regular routes to Scandinavia.

mezinarodni-doprava.lede: Purely Czech company J.M.I.T. — reliability in international road haulage.
bullets: More than 8.5 million km per year
body: We provide transport of material and goods across central, western and northern Europe. Most often we handle high-volume shipments, but when needed we deliver goods on an express basis to other parts of the European Union.

We can arrange shipments from one kilogram up to 24 tonnes. We also have certified drivers for transporting dangerous materials — flammables. Our priority is to deliver the goods at the agreed time and to provide maximum service.

vnitrostatni-doprava.lede: J.M.I.T. trucks crossing the roads throughout the Czech Republic.
bullets: Transport up to 24 t anywhere in CZ
body: We are among the largest road carriers in the Olomouc Region and have provided top-tier transport services for many years. Our main specialisation is high-volume goods.

We operate special cargo rigs with a capacity of up to thirty-eight Euro pallets. We can carry bulky goods to the other end of the country without needing oversize-cargo permits — saving costs and time on domestic transport.
In addition to high-volume cargo, we also handle dangerous goods (excluding explosives). Our drivers regularly attend the necessary training.

spedice.lede: We deliver your shipment quickly to the required destination.
body: We arrange shipments to places our own vehicles do not reach. We work only with vetted partners to maintain the standard our customers are used to.
We arrange warehousing for our customers and, where required, customs formalities for imports and exports. We operate our own logistics centre at the Hlubočky headquarters.

pojisteni.lede: Every shipment we move is covered by up to CZK 10,000,000 of insurance.
body: Every shipment moving through our network is insured. The insurance limit is CZK 10 million per transport. We are happy to send the policy details to customers on request.

fleetPage.metaDescription: Almost 100 modern DAF and Mercedes-Benz rigs with GPS tracking. Trailers with DIN EN 12642 Code XL tarpaulins.
fleetPage.heroDescription: DAF and Mercedes-Benz tractors and flatbeds with GPS tracking and DIN EN 12642 Code XL certified tarpaulins.
fleetPage.p1: We run nearly 100 modern high-volume and trailer rigs. They are mostly tractors or flatbeds from DAF and Mercedes-Benz. Our trailers and semi-trailers meet strict EU standards and have a capacity of up to 38 Euro pallets. For quick delivery of smaller cargo we use vans.
fleetPage.p2: Effective fleet utilisation is the responsibility of our dispatch team. The coordinators work 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Tracking systems provide constant supervision over trucks in the field — real-time data on position, driving style and speed.
fleetPage.p3: Experienced technicians look after the condition of our fleet. Keeping the rigs in perfect shape is a basic prerequisite for successfully delivering the shipment. Cargo insurance is also included.
equipment: Tarpaulins certified to DIN EN 12642 Code XL

referencesPage.metaDescription: We transport for Mora Moravia, Shell, Bridgestone, Whirlpool, Nokian Tyres, Barum, Baumit and others.
referencesPage.heroDescription: Our long-term partners include manufacturers of automotive components, tyres, white goods and insulation materials.
referencesPage.quote: "Transport of goods at the highest quality and the shortest time. Representing the Czech Republic across Europe."

careerPage.metaDescription: We're hiring international truck drivers. Stable Czech company, dedicated assigned vehicle, above-standard pay.
careerPage.heroDescription: Our drivers cover almost 9 million kilometres a year — roughly twelve trips to the Moon and back. We have a stable team and many drivers stay with us for 10, 20 or more years.
careerPage.destinationsBody: Most often within the EU. Which truck will you drive? Find out in the Fleet section — we regularly renew our DAF and Mercedes-Benz fleet.
